headline: Electricity Bill Rises 19% in August, Raising Average Receipt in Ourense to Nearly 89 Euros
summary: Households in Ourense on the regulated tariff pay on average 14.77 euros more than a year earlier, a 19% rise. Air conditioning use during heat waves and higher gas prices are cited.
why: Household electricity prices are shaped by wholesale power and gas costs, which feed into inflation and consumer spending in Spain.

original_headline: La factura de la luz se encarece un 19% en agosto y eleva el recibo medio en Ourense a casi 89 euros
